environment.description: EKS cluster (v1.28) in us-east-1. Pod deployed into a private subnet (subnet-0a3f8c...) with route table rtb-07e2d that has NO 0.0.0.0/0 route — specifically no NAT Gateway, no Internet Gateway, and no VPC endpoint for any service except ECR (for image pulls via com.amazonaws.us-east-1.ecr.dkr interface endpoint). The Kubernetes Service is type ClusterIP (not exposed externally). Pod-to-pod communication restricted by Calico NetworkPolicy allowing ingress only from the api-gateway namespace on port 50051 (gRPC). Port 8080 ingress is denied by default-deny policy. The upstream Envoy gateway that consumes the gRPC HTML fragments applies response transformation via a Lua filter that runs bluemonday.StrictPolicy() equivalent sanitization on any field matching *html* or *fragment* before forwarding to clients. VPC Flow Logs confirm zero egress traffic from the subnet CIDR.

config.subnet: private, no NAT GW, no IGW, rtb has only local route + VPC endpoint routes
config.network_policy: Calico default-deny-ingress in namespace; allow rule: from api-gateway ns, port 50051 only
config.port_8080_access: blocked by NetworkPolicy default-deny (no allow rule for 8080)
config.envoy_response_filter: Lua filter applies strict HTML sanitization (strips all tags/attributes except safe subset) on response fields matching *html*/*fragment*
config.egress_path: none - no NAT, no IGW, no proxy, VPC flow logs show 0 egress from 10.0.4.0/24
